text: A magic that grants substantial healing to units in battle and can even resurrect the fallen.
Heals friendly units for a period of time.
Grants a defensive boon to nearby troops.
Enhances armor-piercing shots for a period of time.
The Sun Knight's weapon flares with radiant light during a charge, blinding enemies.
The Sun Knight and their steed transform into a beam of light, becoming a spirit unit.
The Sun Knight and their steed revert to mortal flesh.
